rows.ARS:
Red blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Abracadabra
rows.Origin: Discovered by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2001).
rows.Bloom: Yellow and red, stripes. Flowers deep red/brown with lemon yellow stripes. None to mild fragrance. Average diameter 2.75". Medium, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, few or no prickles/thorns. Matte, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm).

Trade reference: Abracadabra

Spontaneous Mutation: found in Korflapei

First sold in Netherlands, October 2001.

Patent surrendered on November 13, 2025.
